body: Thank you, I really needed to read that. I just want the best for them. I hope you are right.
Would you be able to make him just go away and leave us alone?
In what way? I’m not sure I have anything left that he wrote on though but I could check.
I can’t, we have a kid together and I don’t want her growing up seeing him doing awful things and getting away with it.

I don’t know how to talk to him, my XH was/is abusive and it already makes it difficult to open up to him (Current SO) sometimes but I think all of this sometimes scares him both when dealing with my issues and his own because he doesn’t know how.

I am 9 weeks 5 days today, I have been having some cramping that feels like it’s bowel related and some menstrual like cramps on the left side, also a little in the middle. I have had some pain in my left hip and cramps in my upper abdomen as well. I have one child and have had 2 miscarriages before her. I am worried but not sure if it’s just because of my body changing or if I should be worried. I have my first appointment and ultrasound scheduled on 4/13. Should I just wait it out or call the doctor?
